candidates.description: This vector activates for common Thai syllable components, vowel markers, and sub-word character n-grams.
This vector represents common Thai syllable suffixes, functional word fragments, and orthographic components.
These tokens represent the Thai consonant 'ท' (tho thahan) often combined with various Thai vowel and tone mark combinations.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ส' (so sua) appearing in various phonetic and contextual combinations.
This feature vector represents common Thai noun-forming prefixes, suffixes, and nominalizers centered around the root word "การ" (kan).
This feature vector activates on a diverse mix of capitalized English lifestyle topics and isolated non-Latin script characters, lacking a unified semantic concept.
This vector represents fragments of Thai script and proper noun components from multilingual text tokens.
This vector is related to subword tokens and fragments from mixed-script languages, particularly Thai and English.
This vector activates on adjective-forming suffixes, historical contexts, and mixed-script tokens.
This feature vector represents linguistic tokens and subwords related to the French word for all or the English words "tour" and "tourist."
